technical_facts.label: Reviewed Normal / Low Power sample
technical_facts.value: 256 MP4 files: 29 driving and 35 parking per camera. All four cameras measured H.264 at 30 fps. Owner confirms HDR on front and interior, off rear and telephoto.

technical_facts.label: HDR and 2K bitrate
technical_facts.value: All three 2K cameras measured about 14.33 Mbps driving and 4.095 Mbps parking despite different HDR settings. This configuration shows no meaningful bitrate difference; it does not establish that toggling HDR never changes bitrate.

technical_facts.label: Storage evidence boundary
technical_facts.value: Older original scans lack paired file-size/duration measurements. The newer High resubmission and Low structural scan provide paired whole-file measurements; keep quality configurations separate. Low four-channel full 60-second driving clips occupy 28.94 decimal GB/hour combined, versus about 28.20 GB/hour from encoded video alone. This includes file padding, audio and container overhead.

technical_facts.label: Reviewed High / Low Bitrate sample
technical_facts.value: 100 items: 40 driving MP4, 20 Protected MP4, 28 parking MP4 and 12 JPG. Each camera has 10 driving, five protected, seven parking videos and three photos. Owner reports manual emergency events; HDR and firmware not recorded.

technical_facts.label: Parking-rate comparison
technical_facts.value: Observed parking video is about 4.095 Mbps per camera in Low, Normal and High scans. The Low scan parking setting was not supplied; Normal has conflicting labels (submission says Low Bitrate, earlier chat says Low Power). Matching rates do not prove mode equivalence. Controlled Maximum and matched-mode tests remain outstanding.

technical_facts.label: Sampled filename family
technical_facts.value: MP4: YYYY_MMDD_HHMMSS_SEQUENCE[F/R/I/T/PF/PR/PI/PT].MP4; JPG: YYYY_MMDD_HHMMSS_SEQUENCE[F/R/I/T].JPG. No separator between sequence and suffix. Bounded sample contains 72 MP4 and eight JPG names; no emergency-specific marker appears, but per-name categories and folder paths are absent.

technical_facts.label: Protected recording boundary
technical_facts.value: 20 Protected videos retain approximately High driving rates: front 36.8-36.9 Mbps, each 2K camera about 21.3 Mbps. Duration range 8.533333-60 seconds does not prove event-window length, buffering, event-to-clip grouping or synchronized four-camera protection.

technical_facts.label: Driving bitrate settings
technical_facts.value: Owner confirms four settings: Low, Normal, High, Maximum. Low Bitrate continuous parking is distinct from Low Power Impact Detection. Impact-triggered Low Power bitrate still needs a controlled measurement; do not assume the earlier 4.095 Mbps sample identifies the mode.

technical_facts.label: Reviewed Low structural sample
technical_facts.value: 2104 items: 2032 driving MP4 (508 per camera), 36 parking MP4, 20 RO MP4 (16 driving and four parking), and 16 JPG. Low driving video is about 27.04 Mbps front and 11.88 Mbps each interior/rear/telephoto. All video groups are H.264/30 fps.

technical_facts.label: Protected folder and lock evidence
technical_facts.value: All 20 sampled RO clips report userImmutable=true; other sampled media report false. All 120 sampled files have POSIX 0700, filesystemReadOnly=false, systemImmutable=false and volumeReadOnly=false. Lock flags, not absent POSIX write bits, distinguish these protected files on this mount.

technical_facts.label: Structural filename linkage
technical_facts.value: Movie driving and RO driving use F/R/I/T MP4 suffixes; Parking and RO parking use PF/PR/PI/PT MP4 suffixes. Photo contains JPG with both suffix families. Protected samples form four driving timestamp sets and one parking timestamp set, each spanning four channels. No extra emergency suffix appears; trigger causality, exact frame sync and event-window policy remain unverified.

technical_facts.label: Configuration comparisons pending
technical_facts.value: Owner plans three-channel and multiplexing scans. Record exact connected camera roles, driving bitrate, parking mode, resolution/fps, HDR, firmware and multiplexing setting separately. No three-channel front-bitrate increase or multiplexing effect has yet been measured.

technical_facts.label: Normal parking label conflict
technical_facts.value: The original Normal submission notes say low bitrate parking mode, while the earlier Discord description says low power parking. Retain this conflict; neither bitrate nor filenames alone resolves the selected mode.

notes: The older Max-setting submission contained 387 media items; telephoto was Unknown under generic fallback and its parking setting was not supplied. Keep those mixed historical ranges separate from the newer Normal-setting sample.

The Normal / Low Power scan has 256 MP4 and eight mode/channel groups. HDR settings are owner-confirmed for that scan only. The High / Low Bitrate scan additionally validates sampled filename families; all folder paths remain unverified.

2026-10-08 Low scan validates previously inferred folder paths and sampled protection linkage. Preserve older evidence limitations as historical context. High resubmission repeats the prior 100-item media summaries, so it is not another quality-setting test; it adds paired storage samples.
